enunciado: In the sorted array {2, 5, 8, 12, 16, 23, 38, 56, 72, 91} search for 23 and 7 with iterative binary search, showing lo, hi and mid at each step.
objetivos: Understand why the array must be sorted
See how the interval is halved
pistas: If a[mid] < x, the answer is on the right: lo = mid + 1.
The loop ends when lo > hi.
